text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-sama.
There is still a place I would like to visit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to help me
look for what I've lost~?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.text:
"She's probably looking for something precious to her.
If she's in trouble, I want to helpâso I decided to follow Mejiro Bright..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, the fish over there are so lovely.
I wonder what they are called~?
choice_data_list: (Wait, an aquarium...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The caudal fin looks just like frills... Hehe, I would love to try wearing something like that too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That fish over there is quite lovely as well.
Puffed up round like a pair of haut-de-chausses♪
Look, Trainer, over there!

Haut-de-chausses pumpkin pants
and ruffles... Is she searching for clothing?
...I suppose I'll watch over her a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howawawaa~... It's bitter~.
It really needs milk and sugar after all...
choice_data_list: Why black...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that maybe, just maybe,
'it wouldn't be bitter today'~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "...Coffee really is such a bitter drink. It still lingers on my tongue~."

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
This is so sweet and delicious!
The latte art is adorable too, it's the absolute best!
choice_data_list: ...Bright, I have a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~~...
What lovely bear latte art~!
And it's so~ very sweet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ Trainer?
You have a latte mustache~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Mmm-yeeesss! How peaceful and idyllic~.

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moo-oo-oo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ The cow is relaxing so peacefully too.
Just as laid-back as me, we match...

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moo-oo-oo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Moo~, moooo~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, telling us to take it easy...
Mr. Cow is so kind~.
choice_data_list: They're actually having a conversation!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How about you as well, Trainer~?
I believe we could become wonderful friends.
choice_data_list: M-Mooo...?

text_block_list.text:
In the end, we made it all the way back to the Academy without ever finding out what she was looking for...
Did she perhaps forget about it entirely?
choice_data_list: Bright, that thing you're looking for—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Thanks to you, I found it.
Thank you so much~
choice_data_list: Huh, when did you find that?
Huh, when did you find that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Together with you, Trainer,
I found so many.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My... "treasure"...♪
choice_data_list: A treasure...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My precious treasures—
Maki-chan, Lolita fashion,
antiques, everyday memories...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I've kept it locked
in my heart's "treasure chest,"
gazing upon it all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: However, spending time with you, Trainer—I came to realize something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When we gaze upon the "treasure chest" together,
the "treasure" shines all the brighter... or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And... I thought to myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What will happen if my "treasures" keep increasing?
If only we could keep gazing into the "treasure box"
together, more and more—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thinking how wonderful that must be.
choice_data_list: I wonder if I was able to help out properly today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My! What a curious thing to say~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I could never have found the 'treasure' of today
all by myself~♪"
choice_data_list: What kind of "treasure" should we search for next?
Let's keep searching enthusiastically!
A "treasure box" in your heart... that's wonderful.
A "treasure box" in your heart... that's lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I could never have found the 'treasure' of today
all by myself~♪"
choice_data_list: What kind of "treasure" should we search for next?
Let's keep searching enthusiastically!
A "treasure box" in your heart... that's wonderful.
A "treasure box" in your heart... that's lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, it's so hard to choose~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, the day after, next week, next year...
We have plenty of time, after all~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That is it~! Why don't you tell me about your "treasures", Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course, sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu.
I'm so looking forward to seeing what kind of brilliance awaits us~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am certain you will find it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“Still... let's not push ourselves too hard,
and take our time searching~”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ordinary times, ordinary places.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That is one of my "treasures" too, after all...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, there are plenty of others as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The beautiful seashell I found when we went to the beach...
The wristband Big Sister Ryan gave me.
The picture book I drew with Dober when we were little—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, is it this late already~?
choice_data_list: Something to look forward to tomorrow, then.
Something to look forward to tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Tomorrow, and the day after.
Building up the anticipation day by day is wonderful too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us continue another time.
Now I have even more to look forward to~~♪
